summary.text: Ethan Cha is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 47B, in office since January 2023, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Unaffiliated candidate Kim Wilson.

paragraphs.text: Ethan Cha lives in Woodbury, Minnesota.
He defeated Kelly Fenton in the November 8, 2022, general election for District 47B and defeated Dwight Dorau on November 5, 2024.
For 2025-2026 he serves on the Commerce Finance and Policy and Legacy Finance committees.
